Setting remove_navigation to false preserves nav and aside elements

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<nav>SiteMenu</nav><main><p>MainContent</p></main><aside>SidebarText</aside>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(preprocessing: HtmlToMarkdown::PreprocessingOptions.new(remove_navigation: false)))
puts result.content.inspect
```
